owner_and_team.owners_note: Q6 lists both founders/owners; individual roles not specified.
owner_and_team.owner_background: Black Truffle Catering is a full-service Melbourne catering company with extensive experience delivering professional catering services to corporate clients, government organisations, universities, councils, private businesses and major institutions. Leadership, culinary, operations and service teams bring many years of combined hospitality and catering experience. Professional chefs are experienced in high-volume commercial food production, premium event catering, dietary requirement management, menu development and onsite function service.
owner_and_team.why_started: Founded because Melbourne clients deserved more from their caterer than simply having food delivered. The founders saw a gap between restaurant-quality food and dependable, professional catering — clients were frustrated by inconsistent quality, late deliveries, limited service and the need to coordinate multiple suppliers for food, beverages, equipment and event staff. The goal was a bespoke, full-service catering company where one experienced team manages food, beverages, equipment, staffing and coordination, from a small corporate meeting to a large formal function.
owner_and_team.team_note: Chefs supported by trained kitchen, event, administrative, dispatch and delivery personnel. The dispatch and delivery team completes thousands of catering deliveries each year across metropolitan Melbourne, with detailed knowledge of Melbourne's CBD, university campuses, government buildings, council facilities, corporate offices and complex commercial sites — including loading docks, security procedures, goods lifts, restricted vehicle access, multiple reception areas and site-specific delivery instructions.

services: Corporate Catering (including Drop-off, Boardroom, & Individual Meal Boxes)
Full-Service Catering (On-site with staff and equipment)
Functions & Event Catering (Private Parties, Weddings, & Cocktail/Canapé Events)
Morning & Afternoon Teas, Lunches, and Multi-Course Plated Boardroom Meals
Specific Food Packages (Canapés, Finger Food, Platters, & Beverages)
services_note: Six service lines verbatim from Q10. Live nav confirms dedicated pages for corporate catering (with five children: drop-off, office, lunch-dinner, conference-meeting, cocktail-party) and event catering. No page found for 'At Home Meals / Re-heat Meals' — flagged as a content gap for Phase 4.

competitors_note: No competitor domains supplied in the questionnaire and none seeded by the analyst at init. Phase 3b relies entirely on DataForSEO auto-discovery. Melbourne catering SERPs are directory- and listicle-heavy, so auto-discovery may surface content platforms above genuine caterers — worth reviewing Phase 3b output and adding seed_competitors if real competitors are buried.
ideal_customer: Melbourne businesses and corporate clients needing catering for meetings, conferences, boardroom lunches, cocktail events and all-day corporate functions. Also private individuals hosting intimate gatherings, birthday parties, anniversary celebrations and retirement parties. Organisations in CBD buildings, government councils and university campuses are a key group given dispatch familiarity. Plus residential customers wanting restaurant-quality chef-prepared meals to re-heat at home.

commercial.projects_served: Over 1000 companies serviced, 1600 customers serviced, and 6000 deliveries and functions completed each year
commercial.projects_served_note: Q13 figures are annual for deliveries/functions; the company and customer counts are stated without an explicit period.
commercial.pricing_structure: Competitive pricing; no fixed price list or specific pricing published on the website — customers are directed to request a tailored quote. Orders placed via the online ordering system, email (catering@blacktruffle.net.au), or phone (03 9419 9290). Multiple deliveries throughout the day across Melbourne CBD and surrounding suburbs, 7:30am–5:30pm Mon–Fri and 7:30am–12:30pm Sat–Sun. Delivery outside these times/areas may incur additional fees.
commercial.certifications: Team members complete training and certifications required for their roles, including food-safety and responsible-service requirements where applicable. Ongoing food safety training provided.
commercial.compliance: Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ) guidelines and all relevant government regulatory authorities. HACCP-based food safety procedures covering hazard identification, temperature monitoring, safe food handling, allergen management, cleaning and sanitation, staff hygiene, traceability, storage controls and documented corrective actions. Dedicated refrigerated delivery vehicles with documented temperature-control procedures. Complies with applicable Victorian regulatory and local government food-safety obligations.

mission: To deliver exceptional-tasting food and outstanding service, creating a seamless and memorable catering experience for every client.
values: Exceptional Quality — fresh, premium-quality, chef-prepared food using carefully selected ingredients and locally sourced produce wherever possible
Reliability and Consistency — the same high standard every time, from food preparation to delivery and presentation
Outstanding Service — seamless, professional and stress-free through responsive communication, attention to detail and genuine care
Customer Satisfaction — listening to client needs, welcoming feedback and continually striving to exceed expectations
Bespoke Solutions — menus, service and catering solutions tailored to each client's individual requirements, preferences and occasion
community_involvement: Provides opportunities and practical training to people without previous hospitality experience, building workplace skills and career pathways. Works with smaller organisations, community groups and charities on limited budgets to develop practical catering solutions within their constraints. Environmental focus on reducing food and packaging waste, improving ordering and production processes, using resources more efficiently and choosing more sustainable products and practices.
